text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was walking around the 
hot spring town with Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew... We sure walked a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If only I could take a break somewhere... 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, take a look, Trainer-san. Right 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the gesture was a footbath. 
Tourists were leisurely soaking their 
feet.
choice_data_list: Looks like a perfect spot for a break!

Looks like a great spot for a break, 
doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I was just thinkin' the same thing. 
Let's relax over there and have a nice 
little chat, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oof, up we go... Aaah... the water 
temperature is just right...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, this is just the perfect spot for a 
nice, quiet chat...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come over here, Trainer~. All the day's 
exhaustion will just melt away~.
choice_data_list: Well then, excuse me while I join you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However, that was when I realized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind the cheerful girl loomed a 
signboard. Written on it were the words 
"Hell Spring"—!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuhohoho, pure bliss, pure bliss...♪ This 
right here is just right.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Is something the matter, 
Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to disturb her relaxation, you 
brace yourself and dip your feet into the 
hot water with a splash. Then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Heat enveloping the legs. Pouring sweat. 
This water temp feels like it's boiling 
right up...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Look, Trainer. The view through the 
rising steam is quite lovely.
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah...! It's swaying back and forth...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is indeed a breathtaking view, but I'm 
about to scream my lungs out!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what lovely atmosphere~. Ah, 
speaking of atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That souvenir shop we saw earlier. That 
place was pretty nice too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Those pickles look delicious too... Maybe 
I really ought to buy some after all?
choice_data_list:
Shall we go buy some? It looked so 
delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do that! Trainer, what kind of 
pickled vegetables do you like? Cucumbers? 
Turnips? Eggplants?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As for the daikon... Hehe. I'll pickle it 
for you~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sweat poured down like a waterfall, so 
much so that I craved salty pickles 
immediately."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't just walk away now. I 
mean, she's having so much fun talking to 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Are you all right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be it doesn't agree with you? 
The water temperature, I mean. Your face 
is bright red~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My oh my, I knew it...! Sit down right 
there. I've got just the thing for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something cool is suddenly wrapped around 
my neck. ...It's a chilled towel.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Your face is bright red, and you're 
sweating so much. You shouldn't force 
yourself to endure the heat.
choice_data_list: …Sorry. Didn't mean to make you worry.

…Sorry. Didn't mean to make you worry, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to apologize. I understand 
completely, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"You were trying to chat with me, weren't 
you? You really are so kind."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate that you tried to stay by my 
side, I really do. But you see...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If you go and exhaust yourself like that, 
I'll be so lonely, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if we want to stay together for a 
long time, let's make sure neither of us 
pushes ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"You know, I think the secret to two 
people staying together for a long time... 
is 'not trying too hard to accommodate the 
other person.'"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It can't just be about me. It can't just 
be about the other person, either.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Shall the two of us look for a sweet spot 
together?"
choice_data_list: We're both different people, after all.

Bottling it up too much isn't good... I 
guess.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. I won't notice unless you 
tell me, but if you speak up, we can find 
the perfect middle ground.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute gently wiped my forehead with 
a towel. A pleasant breeze blew through.
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll choose the "just right" 
water temperature.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. I think that's the best way 
too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Alright then, pinky swear. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. I won't notice unless you 
tell me, but if you speak up, we can find 
the perfect middle ground.
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll choose the "just right" 
water temperature.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, good girl/boy. That's the most 
important thing~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to stay by Wonder Acute's side 
for a long time, I decided to stop pushing 
myself so hard for just a little while.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true... If you bottle it all up by 
yourself, it makes me feel sad, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go closing yourself off when I'm 
right here beside you, okay? Make sure you 
talk to me, alright?"
choice_data_list:
Okay, I'll make sure we talk things 
through properly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. Looks like you're feeling 
better now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her soaking in the footbath, and me 
sitting on the bench. Keeping that 
comfortable distance, our conversation 
continued.
